integrity: Every preference profile for two and three couples is exhausted. Stability and objective values are independently reconstructed by two implementations, and all incompatible three-couple profiles are canonically quotient-checked under the full relabeling and side-exchange symmetry group.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns complete strict two-sided Stable Marriage, two-sided rank profiles, and minimum worst partner rank. The exact exhaustive boundary is through three couples only; it does not address incomplete lists, ties, one-sided rank-maximality, or larger-market frequencies.
title: Three couples are the first incompatibility between rank-maximality and minimum regret
